decisions.processing_scope: Website GA4 tag (gtag.js) on most site pages: page views and link impressions/clicks with placement attributes, first-party cookie identifiers; daily export to the google_cloud BigQuery project. No app memo or account data.

dpa.assessment: GA terms (Japan, updated 2023-05-15; Google LLC) incorporate the Google Ads Data Processing Terms (v8.0) to the extent in scope; Google says pre-existing accounts outside the EEA, UK and Switzerland must accept them in Admin. Our acceptance is unverified.
dpa.action: Check the account Data Processing Amendment status before any expansion; do not claim processor terms apply.

data_use.assessment: Pseudonymous identifiers, pages, referrer, approximate location and device are processed; Google states GA4 does not log or store IP addresses. Data-sharing settings and GA retention were not inspected; the BigQuery copy has no expiration.
data_use.action: Do not add user IDs, new event classes, advertising features or Google signals; keep the privacy policy disclosure current; do not join rows with app or email records.

sla.assessment: No SLA was found for standard Google Analytics; the published SLA covers Analytics 360.
sla.action: Treat missing analytics as missing; do not plan around GA availability.

exit.assessment: Removing the tag stops new collection; a deleted property is permanently removed 35 days after it is moved to trash; the BigQuery copy remains separately.
exit.action: Before exit preserve required aggregates, remove the tag, then handle property and BigQuery copy deletion as separate owner-approved steps.

conditions: Continue only the existing website measurement scope; no new identifiers, events, advertising or signals features.
Before expanding use, confirm the account data-processing acceptance, sharing settings and retention.
Until its retention is decided, do not join GA4 export rows with app, email or account records (comparing daily aggregates is outside this limit).
unresolved: Account owner, accepted Data Processing Amendment, data-sharing settings, GA retention, BigQuery export retention and complete deletion are unverified.

decisions.processing_scope: Ahrefs Web Analytics script on most site pages for page-view counts, and the Ahrefs account used for SEO and backlink observation through manual exports. Account owner and plan are unverified; a paid plan would be a payee outside the vendors allow-list.

dpa.assessment: Terms (updated 2026-09-14; Ahrefs Pte. Ltd., Singapore) bind users to the Data Processing Addendum (updated 2025-09-15). Whether it names Web Analytics was not confirmed.
dpa.action: Do not claim signed coverage; check the DPA scope before adding personal data.

data_use.assessment: Ahrefs states Web Analytics uses no cookies and does not store raw IP addresses (a daily-salted hash of IP and user agent). Retention is not stated.
data_use.action: Keep counting-only use; no identifiers, secrets or customer data.

sla.assessment: Services are provided as is; no uptime commitment was found.
sla.action: Treat gaps as missing data.

exit.assessment: Removing the script stops collection; account deletion is by support request; whether project deletion removes Web Analytics data is not stated.
exit.action: Before exit preserve needed reports, remove the script, then request deletion as a separate step.

conditions: Continue the existing page-view counting and SEO observation only.
Do not send identifiers, secrets or customer data; re-review before enabling new tracked events or integrations.
unresolved: Account owner, plan, DPA scope for Web Analytics, retention and deletion are unverified.
